gospel.text:
[[Lc 6,39]]Jesus told his disciples a parable : "Can a blind person guide a blind person? Will not both fall into a pit?
[[Lc 6,40]]No disciple is superior to the teacher; but when fully trained, every disciple will be like his teacher.
[[Lc 6,41]]Why do you notice the splinter in your brother's eye, but do not perceive the wooden beam in your own?
[[Lc 6,42]]How can you say to your brother, 'Brother, let me remove that splinter in your eye,' when you do not even notice the wooden beam in your own eye? You hypocrite! Remove the wooden beam from your eye first; then you will see clearly to remove the splinter in your brother's eye."
[[Lc 6,43]]A good tree does not bear rotten fruit, nor does a rotten tree bear good fruit.
[[Lc 6,44]]For every tree is known by its own fruit. For people do not pick figs from thornbushes, nor do they gather grapes from brambles.
[[Lc 6,45]]A good person out of the store of goodness in his heart produces good, but an evil person out of a store of evil produces evil; for from the fullness of the heart the mouth speaks.
gospel.title: Holy Gospel of Jesus Christ according to Saint Luke

psalm.text:
[[Ps 92,2]]It is good to give thanks to the LORD, 
To sing praise to your name, Most High,
[[Ps 92,3]]To proclaim your kindness at dawn 
And your faithfulness throughout the night.

[[Ps 92,13]]The just one shall flourish like the palm tree, 
Like a cedar of Lebanon shall he grow.
[[Ps 92,14]]They that are planted in the house of the LORD 
Shall flourish in the courts of our God.

[[Ps 92,15]]They shall bear fruit even in old age; 
Vigorous and sturdy shall they be,
[[Ps 92,16]]Declaring how just is the LORD, 
My rock, in whom there is no wrong.
psalm.title: Psalms

first_reading.text:
[[Si 27,4]]When a sieve is shaken, the husks appear; so do a man's faults when he speaks.
[[Si 27,5]]As the test of what the potter molds is in the furnace, so in his conversation is the test of a man.
[[Si 27,6]]The fruit of a tree shows the care it has had; so too does a man's speech disclose the bent of his mind.
[[Si 27,7]]Praise no man before he speaks, for it is then that men are tested.
first_reading.title: Book of Sirach

second_reading.text:
[[1_Co 15,54]]And when this which is corruptible clothes itself with incorruptibility and this which is mortal clothes itself with immortality, then the word that is written shall come about: "Death is swallowed up in victory.
[[1_Co 15,55]]Where, O death, is your victory? Where, O death, is your sting?"
[[1_Co 15,56]]The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
[[1_Co 15,57]]But thanks be to God who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
[[1_Co 15,58]]Therefore, my beloved brothers, be firm, steadfast, always fully devoted to the work of the Lord, knowing that in the Lord your labor is not in vain.
second_reading.title: First Letter to the Corinthians
